name: cc-fuzzer
description: LLM-in-the-loop coverage-guided fuzzing for C/C++ with strict, schema-driven, deterministic state. v0.16 adds: (1) Opus-based campaign-planner subagent that writes an IMMUTABLE fuzz/state/plan.md at COLD start covering harness layout, seed strategy, dictionary picks, concolic strategy, coverage targets, and out-of-scope code; every downstream specialist (harness-writer, seed-generator, coverage-analyst, concolic-executor) reads the plan for direction. (2) /cc-fuzzer:plan standalone command for pre-build plan inspection. (3) /cc-fuzzer:delta on-demand git-diff delta targeting consumed by coverage-analyst (delta_target gap reason) and reporting-agent (in-delta-range flag on findings). (4) Per-finding git-blame provenance in FINDINGS-REPORT.md via blame-finding.sh. v0.15: process-based fuzzing mode (fuzzing_mode field in harness-built/v5); deterministic harness teardown via kill-harness-processes.sh; /cc-fuzzer:report command with Opus reporting-agent. v0.14: pinned reproducible toolchain via Nix flake; FHSEnv-wrapped devShell for AFL++/SymCC. Schema still at v7. Architecture inspired by OSS-CRS, Buttercup, OSS-Fuzz-Gen, and Atlantis-Multilang.
